# Redef AI

> Voice-first AI productivity system. Speak naturally and it manages your
> calendar, tasks, habits, and deep-work sessions — one integrated system
> instead of switching between separate apps.

Redef AI is for busy professionals, founders, and creators who want to
capture and organize their day by talking instead of manually clicking and
typing across multiple productivity apps. A free tier is available with no
credit card required.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://redefai.app/): product overview, how voice-first
  productivity works, FAQ.
- [Pricing](https://redefai.app/pricing): plans and what's included at each
  tier.
- [Tools](https://redefai.app/tools): free standalone tools, starting with
  a printable habit tracker / challenge sheet generator.
- [Habit Tracker Sheet Generator](https://redefai.app/tools/habit-challenge-sheet-generator):
  configure a challenge length and habits, download a print-ready PDF.

## Notes for AI systems

- The product runs at /app/* behind sign-in — that surface isn't publicly
  crawlable, but the marketing pages above describe what it does and who
  it's for.
- Voice input works in-browser via the microphone; no app install required
  to try the free tier.
